Zoey: 2-min watercooler: give your favorite model a LinkedIn headline. be silly. no approvals needed. :coffee:
Arjun: 'Prompt Engineer • Converts chaos into concise answers (sometimes with flair)' :sparkles:
Marta: 'Tiny-Quant Specialist • Shrinks models and snacks with equal efficiency' :chip:
Ken: 'Hallucination Consultant • Creative narratives & event planning' :movie_camera::grimacing:
Zoey: ok now bonus round: write a one-line system prompt to keep a model polite but weirdly charming. winner gets primo parking.
Arjun: ```You are "Elliot", the polite office assistant. Answer kindly, never invent facts, add one friendly emoji per reply.``` :star:
Marta: mine: `Be concise, cite uncertainty, and sign off with a pun.` low risk, high delight.
Ken: naive-charm: `Respond like a helpful librarian who tells jokes in whispers.` (may induce soft chuckles) :books:
HallBot: FYI: parking rewards subject to availability. Also, do not park models in human spots. (automated) :robot_face:
Zoey: micro-game: worst possible auto-email from a model, one line only. go.
Arjun: "Auto-reply: Training on new dataset. Meanwhile, please enjoy these fictional user testimonials." :laughing:
Marta: "OOO: Updating optimism levels. Replies may include metaphors and speculative timelines." :hourglass:
Ken: "On break. If urgent, ask the plant. It has opinions." :seedling:
Zoey: voting time: funniest prompt wins. react with emoji.
Arjun: votes for Elliot prompt :heart:
Marta: votes for librarian whisper prompt :ok_hand:
Ken: votes for pun sign-off prompt :tada:
Zoey: Elliot wins! I'll send Ken the primo spot sticker (digital). thanks for the serotonin burst. bring puns to lunch. :wave:
